correctness.rationale: Analytic perturbation on a uniformly elliptic two-state diffusion on a compact circle gives invariant measure and Poisson corrector with identical explicit first-harmonic amplitudes; exact martingale quadratic variation contains Brownian and internal-state redraw terms. Their second-order expansion yields the coefficient. Half-period translation removes all odd powers. The discriminant and derivative prove the complete second-order sign boundary and unique rate optimum. Fourier collocation independently validated full generator/corrector at 45 cases; the analytic argument, not finite enumeration, establishes the theorem.

value.rationale: The probability of an activated periodic trap is an intrinsic control parameter in on/off flashing. The sharp duty threshold q=1/9 separates the possibility of diffusion acceleration from its impossibility to quadratic order, with a nontrivial bounded window of activating rates and a unique optimal rate 3Dk². This resolves a specific transport-design gap left by the published equal-duty example; it is not a normalization artifact, arbitrary slice or merely an unexplained finite computation.
